children: Indonesia posted a budget deficit of 240.1 trillion rupiah ($13.55 billion) in the first eight months of 2026, equivalent to 0.93% of gross domestic product, its new Finance Minister Suahasil Nazara said on Friday.

The government collected 2,055.6 trillion rupiah of revenues as of the end of August, up 25.4% from the same period last year. It spent 2,295.7 trillion rupiah, up 17.1% year on year, the minister said.

Suahasil was this week named as President Prabowo Subianto's third finance minister in less than two years, after the president sacked Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa. Suahasil was previously deputy finance minister.

Purbaya implemented unconventional fiscal policies, but failed to allay growing market concerns about Prabowo's costly spending plans, political interference at the central bank and transparency issues at the stock exchange.
